title: A Reduced-Trace-Zero Element That Is Not a Commutator in a Central Division Algebra
summary: We exhibit a finite-dimensional central division algebra, of degree four over its center, together with an explicit element of reduced trace zero that is not a single commutator. This answers negatively the single-commutator question for finite-dimensional central division algebras, the case left open by Amitsur and Rowen.
